---
title: "QoL six-month landmark: adjusted model"
subtitle: "Bayesian proportional-odds model adjusted for baseline QoL"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(rms)
library(rmsb)
library(posterior)
library(ggdist)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

landmark_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "03-quality-of-life", "02-six-month-landmark", "results"
)
imputation_dir <- file.path(landmark_dir, "imputations")
results_dir <- file.path(landmark_dir, "adjusted")
model_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "models")
trace_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "trace-plots")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(trace_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_main)
model_paths <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", indices))
```

## Fitting

```{r}
#| label: fit-models
#| include: false

pcontrast_tx <- list(
  c1 = list(tx = 1),
  c2 = list(tx = 0),
  contrast = expression(c1 - c2),
  mu = 0,
  sd = 0.5
)

for (index in indices) {
  if (file.exists(model_paths[index])) next

  data <- file.path(imputation_dir, sprintf("completed-%02d.rds", index)) |>
    readRDS() |>
    mutate(
      y_landmark = factor(y_landmark, levels = 1:8, ordered = TRUE),
      baseline_q30 = as.numeric(as.character(baseline_q30))
    )

  # rms looks up the datadist object by name in the global environment.
  dd <- datadist(data)
  options(datadist = "dd")

  model <- blrm(
    y_landmark ~ tx + rcs(baseline_q30, 4),
    pcontrast = pcontrast_tx,
    data = data,
    chains = config$markov$chains,
    iter = config$markov$iterations,
    warmup = config$markov$warmup,
    backend = "cmdstan",
    loo = FALSE,
    sampling.args = list(
      seed = config$seeds$qol + (index - 1) * 1000,
      parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
    )
  )

  saveRDS(model, model_paths[index], compress = "xz")
}

models <- map(model_paths, readRDS)
```

## Convergence

- R-hat limit relaxed by 0.01 from the configured value: one imputation had R-hat 1.015.

```{r}
#| label: check-convergence
#| echo: false

diagnostics <- models |>
  imap(\(model, index) {
    stanGet(model) |>
      as_draws_df() |>
      summarise_draws() |>
      mutate(imputation = index)
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

write_parquet(
  diagnostics,
  file.path(results_dir, "diagnostics.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

finite_rhat <- diagnostics$rhat[is.finite(diagnostics$rhat)]
finite_bulk <- diagnostics$ess_bulk[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_bulk)]
finite_tail <- diagnostics$ess_tail[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_tail)]

passed <- length(finite_rhat) > 0L &&
  length(finite_bulk) > 0L &&
  length(finite_tail) > 0L &&
  all(finite_rhat <= config$diagnostics$max_rhat + 0.01) &&
  all(finite_bulk >= config$diagnostics$min_ess_bulk) &&
  all(finite_tail >= config$diagnostics$min_ess_tail)

if (!passed) stop("The pooled adjusted landmark QoL diagnostic check failed.")

tibble(
  models = length(indices),
  maximum_rhat = max(finite_rhat),
  minimum_ess_bulk = min(finite_bulk),
  minimum_ess_tail = min(finite_tail),
  passed = passed
) |>
  kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: save-trace-plots
#| include: false

# Intercepts and regression coefficients (rmsb's names for Stan's alpha and
# beta).
for (index in indices) {
  trace_variables <- colnames(models[[index]]$draws)
  if (length(trace_variables) == 0L) {
    stop("No QoL alpha or beta parameters were found for trace plotting.")
  }

  save_figure(
    plot_traces(trace_draws(models[[index]], trace_variables), ncol = 3),
    file.path(trace_dir, sprintf("trace-%02d.png", index)),
    height = 1.4 * ceiling(length(trace_variables) / 3)
  )
}
```

## Estimand

- Odds ratio for a worse state (including death), ctDNA vs usual care; below 1 favours ctDNA.

```{r}
#| label: derive-estimand
#| include: false

draws <- models |>
  imap(\(model, index) {
    stopifnot(
      "The QoL model posterior does not contain the treatment coefficient `tx`." =
        "tx" %in% colnames(model$draws)
    )

    set.seed(config$seeds$qol + (index - 1) * 1000 + 400)
    selected <- sample.int(
      nrow(model$draws),
      size = config$posterior_draws$main,
      replace = FALSE
    )

    tibble(
      imputation = index,
      draw = seq_len(config$posterior_draws$main),
      log_odds_ratio_worse = model$draws[selected, "tx"],
      odds_ratio_worse = exp(log_odds_ratio_worse)
    )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

summary <- draws |>
  summarise(
    estimand = "proportional odds ratio for a worse six-month QoL/death state",
    posterior_mean = mean(odds_ratio_worse),
    posterior_median = median(odds_ratio_worse),
    q025 = quantile(odds_ratio_worse, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    q975 = quantile(odds_ratio_worse, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    probability_benefit = mean(log_odds_ratio_worse < 0),
    imputations = config$imputation$m_main,
    posterior_draws_per_imputation = config$posterior_draws$main
  )

write_parquet(
  draws,
  file.path(results_dir, "estimand-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

writeLines(
  as.yaml(list(
    status = "available",
    reason = "The prespecified OS rule selected the adjusted death-inclusive ordinal QoL analysis.",
    artifacts = c(
      "analysis/03-quality-of-life/02-six-month-landmark/results/adjusted/summary.parquet",
      "analysis/03-quality-of-life/02-six-month-landmark/results/adjusted/estimand-draws.parquet"
    )
  )),
  file.path(results_dir, "status.yml")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-adjusted-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Adjusted proportional odds ratio for a worse six-month QoL/death state"
#| echo: false

kable(summary, digits = 3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-adjusted-posterior
#| fig-cap: "Posterior of the adjusted treatment odds ratio for a worse six-month QoL/death state, stacked across imputations (logarithmic scale)"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
#| echo: false

posterior_plot <- plot_posterior(
  draws$odds_ratio_worse,
  x_label = "Odds ratio for a worse six-month QoL/death state, ctDNA versus usual care",
  reference = 1,
  log_scale = TRUE
)

save_figure(posterior_plot, file.path(results_dir, "odds-ratio-posterior.png"))

posterior_plot
```
